column1: REGISTRATION  OF  TITLE ACT, No.  21 OF  1998
Declaration  of  Determination  of  the  Commissioner  of  Title  Settlement  under  Section  14
BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-
clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the  title to parcel of Land No. 130 of Block 01, con-
tained in the Cadastral Map No. 830081, situated in the Village of Yodhakandiya within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 15 - Yod-
hakandiya in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Tissamaharamaya, in the District of Hambantota, in the Province of Southern, re-
ferred to in Notice No. 83/0114 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 1687/21 of 05th January,
2011 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998.
